title: Zinda Me Tha Sakina Ka Nouha Mere Baba
body:
Zinda Me Tha Sakina Ka Nouha Mere Baba
Dasta Hai Mere Dil Ku Aandhera Mere Baba
1.Hai Saath Mere Shaam-e-Ghareeba Ke Aandhere
Kya Janiye Kal Honga Sawera Mere Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Is Sin Me Judai Ka Garabar Uthao
Lao Main Kahan Se Wo Kaleja mere Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Aatey Hai Agar Yaad Mujhe Apke Boose
Padhta Hai Muh Pa Tamacha Mere Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Dadi Ki Tarha Todh Gayi Phasliya Meri
Wo Dard Hai Pal Bhar Nahin Thamta Mere Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Sab Log Reha Hokey Chale Jaienge Yasrab
Rehjaungi Main Qaid Me Tanha Mere Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Yeh Dekhiye Khuli Mera Khaicha Hau Bundhe
Mera Hai Meri Pusht Pe Naiza Mere Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Kya Ab Mujhe Dekhunge Toh Paichan Sakunge
Badla Hai Ghamou Se Mera Chehra Mere Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
8.Is Khakh Ke Bistar Ne Mujhe Mardiya Hai
Uthti Hu Toh Yeh Jism Hai Dukhta Mere Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
9.Hai Dil Se Bilal Apka Ghamkhar Azadar
Sadqe Me Usse Apke Bakhsha Mere Baba
